headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 10, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, led by Logan Gilbert's 6.0 innings pitched and 5 strikeouts. The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 12-3, with Andy Pages hitting a home run and three RBIs. The Tampa Bay Rays edged the Boston Red Sox 4-3, with Nick Martinez earning the win.

Injuries and availability impact are affecting several teams. Oneil Cruz has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Pittsburgh Pirates due to left hand fourth and fifth metacarpal non-displaced fractures. The Los Angeles Angels have placed Sebastián Rivero on the 10-day injured list with a left hamate fracture and transferred Jack Kochanowicz to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the Kansas City Royals, Seattle Mariners, Chicago White Sox, Atlanta Braves, and Los Angeles Angels.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Detroit Tigers acquired Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers, while the Pittsburgh Pirates traded Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded Raynel Delgado to the Houston Astros for cash, and the Arizona Diamondbacks traded Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Texas Rangers traded Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a hard-fought win against the Baltimore Orioles, outlasting their opponents 6-5. Logan Gilbert led the Mariners' pitching effort with 6.0 innings pitched, striking out 5 batters while allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Dominate Pirates in 12-3 Rout**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a convincing 12-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, behind a strong team effort. Andy Pages led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Paul Skenes pitched 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Red Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Marcelo Mayer led the Red Sox offense with a 2-RBI performance, including a crucial double that scored two runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 10-4**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 10-4 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen leading the way on the mound. Impact hitters for the Rays included Yandy Díaz and Taylor Walls, while Ceddanne Rafaela and Caleb Durbin stood out for the Red Sox.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón leading the way on the mound. Impact hitters for the Yankees included José Caballero and Angel Martínez, while Paul Goldschmidt and Trent Grisham stood out for the Guardians.

top_news.title: **Pirates' Cruz Sidelined with Hand Injuries**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates center fielder Oneil Cruz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to non-displaced fractures in his left hand's fourth and fifth metacarpal bones. The injury occurred on June 8, 2026.

top_news.title: **Waguespack Joins Tigers**
top_news.summary: Right-handed pitcher Jacob Waguespack has been traded to the Detroit Tigers. The move comes after the Milwaukee Brewers dealt Waguespack to the Tigers.
